description_en: Retrieves the check item configurations for cloud platform configuration checks
description_zh: 获取云平台配置检查配置项
name: GetCheckConfig

items.description_en: The day of the week on which the periodic check is performed
items.description_zh: 周期执行时间点，取值表示每周周几

EnableAddCheck.description_en:
Indicates whether new check items added to the selected standards are checked by default. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
EnableAddCheck.description_zh:
当所选条例中有新增检查项时，是否默认检查。可取值：

true： 开启
false： 关闭

EnableAutoCheck.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic periodic checks are enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
EnableAutoCheck.description_zh:
是否开启自动周期检测。可取值：

true： 开启
false： 关闭

EndTime.description_en:
The end hour of the check time window, indicating the hour of the day when the check ends. The start time and end time must be within one of the following time ranges:

0~6: If the start time is 0, the end time must be set to 6.
6~12: If the start time is 6, the end time must be set to 12.
12~18: If the start time is 12, the end time must be set to 18.
18~24: If the start time is 18, the end time must be set to 24
EndTime.description_zh:
检查时间段结束时间，表示每天几点。 查询的开始时间和结束只能在以下时间区间中选择。

0~6当开始时间为0时，结束时间需要设置为当日6时。
6~12 当开始时间为6时，结束时间需要设置为当日12时。
12~18 当开始时间为12时，结束时间需要设置为当日18时。
18~24当开始时间为18时，结束时间需要设置为当日24时

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use it to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

SelectedChecks.description_en: The check items selected in the policy

CheckId.description_en: The ID of the check item

SectionId.description_en: The section ID of the check item

Standards.description_en: The list of check item information

Id.description_en: The ID of the check item

ShowName.description_en: The name of the check item

Status.description_en:
The enabling status of the check item. Valid values:

ON: Enabled.
OFF: Shutdown
Status.description_zh:
检测项开启状态。可取值：

ON： 开启
OFF： 关闭

Type.description_en:
The type of the check item. Valid values:

RISK: Cloud service configuration management.
IDENTITY_PERMISSION: Identity and permission management.
COMPLIANCE: Compliance
Type.description_zh:
检测项类型。可取值：

RISK： 云产品配置管理
IDENTITY_PERMISSION：  身份权限管理
COMPLIANCE： 合规

StartTime.description_en: The start hour of the check time window, indicating the hour of the day when the check starts
StartTime.description_zh: 检查时间段开始时间，表示每天几点
